native_model: High-dimensional motor learning model with synergy-factorized forward map and co-adapting inverse controller
memory_representation_state: learned forward/inverse parameter structure is retained skill/model state; target and trajectory are outside
learned_parameters: forward-model parameters updated by prediction error
inverse-controller parameters updated by task/control error gradient
action_skill_variables: low-dimensional synergy coefficients / motor command generated by inverse controller
retrieval_readout_rules: current learned maps are read/executed to generate prediction and motor command
learning_plasticity_rules: source-defined gradient updates for forward and inverse models; prediction error is a learning signal, not persistent coordinator state
model_variants: source HML conditions and simulation variants
negative_adverse_results: The model is fitted/normative; human trajectories do not directly measure the proposed forward/inverse neural states.
Generalization from established adaptation coevolution to de-novo skill learning requires care.
Motor synergies are an internal representation/factorization choice and must not be confused with the externally imposed target-capture task.
Exact exponential convergence is conditional: no inverse exploration noise, persistently exciting perceptual/motion input, sufficiently small gamma^2/(eta k_P), and initialization in Omega_c.
With stochastic exploration noise, trajectories remain in an O(|sigma_u|) neighborhood rather than converge exactly to zero.
anti_conflation_assertions: external target is not internal skill state
physical body/environment is not an internal stateful coordinator
prediction error is a transient learning signal rather than retained coordinator state
conditional convergence theorem is not empirical motor learning and is not unconditional
learned forward/inverse parameters are source-defined skill/model state, not a new coordinator
